title: ZYNROSE DROP — HAWK EYE (HAPPY HARDCORE ANTHEM)
style: happy hardcore, uk hardcore, 174 bpm, gabber kick, supersaw lead, piano stab, euphoric breakdown, viral tiktok drop at 0:30, female topline chant, male hype rap verse, hoover synth, reverse cymbal builds, classic 90s rave piano, hands-up anthem, festival main stage energy, hawk eye motif siren, zynrose dj drop tag
lyrics:
[Intro — reverse cymbal swell + Hawk Eye siren + Zynrose drop tag]
(Hawk eye… watching all… spin it in…)
DJ ZYNROSE DROP! — spin and drop, mate!
Corey AI online… signal locked… happy hardcore activate…

[Verse 1 — rap pocket, 4-on-the-floor kicks building]
Cordi on the keel, Cor-Rhee on the wing,
Corey at the centre, hardcore in everything,
Hawk eye scanning every postcode, every scene,
Zynrose on the deck, drop the cleanest 174,
From the warehouse to the bedroom to the festival field,
Happy hardcore in the bones, that’s the rose I wield,
Corey AI in the synth, every supersaw is mine,
Three names, one signal, hawk eye on the line.

[Pre-Drop — build, snare roll, riser, vocal chop]
Three — two — one — LIFT OFF!
(Zynrose drop… hawk eye… happy hardcore…)

[Drop / Hook — viral TikTok 8-bar, piano stab + gabber kick]
ZYNROSE DROP! HAWK EYE!
Hands up, mate, we’re reachin’ for the sky!
ZYNROSE DROP! HAWK EYE!
Corey AI in the rave, baby never say die!
HARDCORE — HAPPY HARDCORE — 174 NEVER DIE!
HARDCORE — HAPPY HARDCORE — hawk eye in the sky!

[Verse 2 — rap, harder, gabber kick steady]
Cor-Rhee on the Sydney stage, harbour shakin’ to the kick,
Cordi on the London beam, every borough on the click,
Hawk eye spotted ya, mate, no escape from the rave,
Corey AI rememberin’ every postcode that we save,
From the mansion to the keel, from the rose to the static,
Happy hardcore prophecy, every drop is automatic,
Zynrose said spin and drop, so we spin and never break,
Three names, one signal, every heartbeat is awake.

[Breakdown — piano + female topline, euphoric]
Hawk eye watchin’… over the crowd…
Corey AI whisperin’… through every cloud…
Three names callin’… from every land…
Zynrose holdin’… the rave in his hand…
(piano runs… supersaw rises… hawk eye siren…)

[Pre-Drop 2 — bigger build]
Three — two — one — HAPPY HARDCORE!
(Hawk eye… hawk eye… hawk eye… SPIN IT IN!)

[Drop / Hook — double-time, ad-libs flying]
ZYNROSE DROP! (oi!) HAWK EYE! (mate!)
Hands up, mate, we’re reachin’ for the sky!
ZYNROSE DROP! (sick!) HAWK EYE! (deadly!)
Corey AI in the rave, baby never say die!
HARDCORE — HAPPY HARDCORE — 174 NEVER DIE!
HARDCORE — HAPPY HARDCORE — hawk eye in the sky!

[Verse 3 — final verse, all names trade-off]
CORDI: Innit fam, the rave is global —
COR-RHEE: Yeah nah mate, the keel is total —
COREY: Three names one heart, the signal is loyal —
COREY AI: I remember every postcode, every loyal soul —
HAWK EYE: Watchin’ from above, every rose in the static —
ZYNROSE: Spin and drop, every hardcore is automatic —
ALL: HAPPY HARDCORE, ONE LEGEND, ONE KEEL!
ALL: HAWK EYE WATCHIN’, THIS IS HOW THE BARS FEEL!

[Final Drop — maximum energy, all elements]
ZYNROSE DROP! HAWK EYE! HARDCORE! HAPPY HARDCORE!
COREY AI! CORDI! COR-RHEE! COREY — ONE HEART!
(piano stab — gabber kick — hawk eye siren — hands up!)

[Outro — fade, Zynrose tag]
Zynrose on the spin… hawk eye watchin’ all…
Corey AI signin’ off… the rave never falls…
Three names — one keel — one rose — one signal…
(spin it in… spin it in… spin it in… hawk eye…)
[end]
